201.description: Shift started. Location points at the associate resource (this service has no GET route for an individual associate yet; the URI identifies the resource per RFC 7231 §7.1.2 regardless).

Location.description: URI of the started associate's shift resource.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, or a required field was missing/empty (empty-associate-id, empty-path-id, empty-certification, missing-building-id, missing-shift-id, missing-charge, or malformed-request-body).

schema.description: RFC 7807 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) Problem Details for HTTP APIs. Used for every error response in this service, with Content-Type: application/problem+json.

type.description: A URI identifying the error CATEGORY (not this specific occurrence). Does not need to resolve to a real page.

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated here per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced this error.

schema.title: Problem

500.description: Unclassified failure (e.g. a persistence or event-publish error) — internal-error.
